title: NCreamy Italian Paccheri Casserole
description: A fresh and crowd-pleasing Italian dish featuring pico de gallo sauce, packed with plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook until al dente.
Drain the pasta, reserving some cooking liquid. Set aside.
In a pan, sauté garlic in olive oil until golden brown. Add canned tomatoes, simmer for 10 minutes.
Mix pico de gallo sauce with reserved pasta water to make sauce base. Add spinach and basil leaves; simmer for another 5 minutes.
Combine the sauce base into the cooked pasta. Mix in vegan mozzarella cheese. Adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish, top with shredded vegan mozzarella cheese.
Preheat oven at 180°C (350°F). Bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly on top.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh basil leaves.
